metadata.case_name: LEUNG KA YAN v. SECRETARY FOR JUSTICE (FOR AND ON BEHALF OF THE DIRECTOR OF LEISURE AND CULTURAL SERVICES DEPARTMENT OF THE HONG KONG SPECIAL ADMINISTRATIVE REGION)

plaintiff.occupation_before: Secretary (employed by a law firm since 2004)

source: The agreed diagnosis was fracture right patella.
The patella fracture was healed with mild arthritic changes at the patellofemoral joint. Opacity was detected over the patella ligament.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the knee or lower leg

manifestations.description: Right anterior knee and thigh pain, continuous, Pain increases when walking on slope or climbing stairs. The pain is more severe when descending stairs or walking down slope. She needs to rest after walking up or down one floor of stairs. She would have pain after prolong walking for more than 30 minutes, standing for more than 45 minutes and or sitting for around 2 hours (i.e. watching film). The pain occasionally wakes her up at night, about 3 times a week. The pain also increases during the change of weather. No analgesic intake is required. Subjectively, the pain has improved by ~30-40%. She estimated the severity of her right knee pain is 6 to 9 in a scale of 0 to 10 where 0 is no pain and 10 is maximal pain.
Right knee stiffness associated with limping, causing her unable to squat.
Right knee pigmentation over lateral aspect of her knee.
Limping during tip-toe walking and heel walking.
5cm x 1 cm scar over depressed skin of anterior knee, with tenderness, and a patch of faint hyperpigment of 6cm x 4cm lateral to the scar.
The patella fracture was healed with mild arthritic changes at the patellofemoral joint.

treatments_future: total knee replacement (may be required at around 10-15 years)

losses.description: Needs to rest after walking up or down one floor of stairs; pain after prolonged walking for more than 30 minutes, standing for more than 45 minutes; limping; increased pain when descending stairs or walking down slope.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Used to share housework with husband, but after the accident, housework is mostly done by her husband; difficulties in squatting down; unable to lift heavy object from supermarket that weights more than 10 oranges.
Right knee stiffness, weakness, muscle wasting, 5cm x 1 cm scar, and mild arthritic changes at the patellofemoral joint.
